name: Cherimoya

low.description: About 1/3 cup diced or 2-3 small wedges

siboNotes: Well-tolerated in small portions. The creamy texture may be easier to digest than firmer fruits for some SIBO patients.
preparationTips: Choose fruit that yields slightly to gentle pressure when ripe
Remove all black seeds before eating as they are toxic
Chill before serving for best flavor and texture
Add to smoothies in small amounts for natural sweetness
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin C for immune support
Good source of potassium for heart health
